BackgroundJobOut.description:
One piece of slow work and where it stands; the screen polls this.
Every key is always sent (null when unknown), so the nullable ones have
no default: the generated type then matches lib/jobs.ts, which follows a
job.
BackgroundJobOut.title: BackgroundJobOut

ClaimDependentRelationshipOut.description: A canonical relationship that rests on evidence linked to the claim.
ClaimDependentRelationshipOut.title: ClaimDependentRelationshipOut

ClaimEvidenceLinkOut.description: The link itself, as stored (the reply to linking evidence to a claim).
ClaimEvidenceLinkOut.title: ClaimEvidenceLinkOut

ClaimEvidenceRowOut.description:
One linked evidence record with the source it came from, as the
claim's evidence list and review workspace show it.
ClaimEvidenceRowOut.title: ClaimEvidenceRowOut

ClaimReviewResultOut.description:
The reply to recording a review: the claim as it now stands, the
immutable review event, and the workspace refreshed.
ClaimReviewResultOut.title: ClaimReviewResultOut

DocumentDetailOut.description: A document with its extracted chunks (GET /documents/{id}).
DocumentDetailOut.title: DocumentDetailOut

DocumentUploadOut.description:
The reply to an upload: the saved document, the job that reads it
(already finished in developer mode), and its OpenAleph state.
DocumentUploadOut.title: DocumentUploadOut

EntityUpdate.description:
Partial update: caption and/or new property values.

Property values are additive statements (same provenance ledger used
everywhere else), never overwrites or deletes -- a value already present
for a prop is left as-is; a new one is appended and recorded as a
Statement. Disagreements between old and new values are resolved the
same way any other statement disagreement is: a property-conflict
decision, not this endpoint.
EntityUpdate.title: EntityUpdate

EvidencePoolRow.description: One evidence record with the source it came from.
EvidencePoolRow.title: EvidencePoolRow

ExplanationExcerptOut.description: The matched text with a little of what surrounds it.
ExplanationExcerptOut.title: ExplanationExcerptOut

ExplanationPartOut.description: One part of a proposal: what it says, why, and where it came from.
ExplanationPartOut.title: ExplanationPartOut

ExtractionCandidateOut.description:
One extraction proposal. `explanation` is present only when the list
was asked for explanations (?explain=true), so it is left out of the
reply rather than sent as null.
ExtractionCandidateOut.title: ExtractionCandidateOut

ExtractionExplanationOut.description: Why a proposal exists (#190): per-part reasoning and sources.
ExtractionExplanationOut.title: ExtractionExplanationOut

ExtractionLineageOut.description: The read-only trail document → chunk → proposal → review → accepted record.
ExtractionLineageOut.title: ExtractionLineageOut

ExtractionReviewOut.description:
The reply to a review decision: the proposal as it now stands and, for
an acceptance, the record it made (an entity, claim, evidence record or
relationship, each in its own shape).
ExtractionReviewOut.title: ExtractionReviewOut

LeadLinkOut.description: What a lead points at: exactly one record, named by its kind.
LeadLinkOut.title: LeadLinkOut

LeadQueueOut.description: The leads of a case in triage order, with counts by status.
LeadQueueOut.title: LeadQueueOut

LeadTriageOut.description:
Evidence tension around the records a lead links to: a queue-attention
signal only, never a change to the lead or its records.
LeadTriageOut.title: LeadTriageOut

LineageIntegrityOut.description:
Whether every proposal in the archive still points at its document,
chunk and accepted record.
LineageIntegrityOut.title: LineageIntegrityOut

OpenAlephReviewStatusOut.description: Provider sync plus how far reporter review of its proposals has got.
OpenAlephReviewStatusOut.title: OpenAlephReviewStatusOut

OpenAlephSyncOut.description: How one document stands in the OpenAleph corpus.
OpenAlephSyncOut.title: OpenAlephSyncOut

ProvenanceTraceOut.description:
Everything connected to one record, followed back to its sources.
`root` is the record itself and takes a different shape per record type.
ProvenanceTraceOut.title: ProvenanceTraceOut

QueryRef.description: One catalogued query and its parameters, as the AI writes them.
QueryRef.title: QueryRef

RelationshipOut.description:
One relationship edge with its FollowTheMoney statements, attached
evidence and the advisory the review layer computes. The graph endpoint
adds reconciliation and aggregate-provenance blocks for reviewed
duplicates, so the model stays open to those.
RelationshipOut.title: RelationshipOut

StanceCountsOut.description: How many evidence links take each stance.
StanceCountsOut.title: StanceCountsOut

StatementHistoryRowOut.description:
One property value of an entity: its canonical statements and every
outside assessment of it, with support and conflict counts.
StatementHistoryRowOut.title: StatementHistoryRowOut

TimelineContextOut.description:
What a reporter-authored event points at, as it stands now. Each part
is present only when the event links to that record.
TimelineContextOut.title: TimelineContextOut

TimelineEventOut.description:
One timeline event: a reporter-authored row (which carries `context`),
or one derived from a dated statement, source, relationship or record
activity (`synthetic`, with no context). Derived kinds add their own
keys, so the model stays open.
TimelineEventOut.title: TimelineEventOut

TimelineEventRowOut.description: A reporter-authored event as stored (the reply to creating one).
TimelineEventRowOut.title: TimelineEventRowOut

VisualDataOut.description: What the data service cooked: every value tagged with its records.
VisualDataOut.title: VisualDataOut

VisualPreviewOut.description:
A chart cooked, drawn and checked for one order slip, as the preview
shows it; the AI is never involved.
VisualPreviewOut.title: VisualPreviewOut

VisualQueryOut.description: One entry of the query catalogue the AI orders from.
VisualQueryOut.title: VisualQueryOut

VisualSpec.description:
The order slip. `extra="forbid"` is what keeps numbers out: a model
that tries to add `values` or `items` is refused, not silently
tolerated.

highlight.description: Labels to pick out; the others turn grey.
highlight.title: Highlight

limit.description: Keep the top N; the rest are folded into 'Other'.
limit.title: Limit

title.description: States the finding, e.g. 'Meridian received most of the money'.
title.title: Title

unit.description: Optional unit label; the data's own unit always wins.
unit.title: Unit

VisualSpec.title: VisualSpec

reason as the write-up promotion endpoint above.

Writeup (see app/services/presentation.py). Not idempotent -- each call

from the same underlying draft.

get.description: Describe the runnable core preview without making AI a startup dependency.

post.description:
Create the one demo investigation (sample entities, relationships,
claims/evidence, leads, and a timeline) if it doesn't already exist.
Idempotent -- calling this again just returns the existing one.

Save the file, then read it as a background job.

On PostgreSQL (the product) this answers 202 as soon as the file is saved:
the document is ``queued`` and ``job`` says how to follow it
(GET /api/jobs/{id}). In developer mode (SQLite) the job runs before the
reply, off the event loop, so the answer is the read document as before.
Stage OpenAleph/ftm-analyze Mention entities for explicit reporter review.
Stage OpenAleph page text as review-required evidence candidates.
Refresh OpenAleph Page + Mention candidates without auto-accepting either.

get.description: Report provider sync plus human-review queue progress for one document.
Per-part reasoning and sources behind one proposal (#190). Read-only.
Report whether the local OpenAleph corpus platform is actually reachable.

The review queue for TAS reasoning output, newest first. Payloads are
omitted here; GET /ai-analysis-candidates/{id} returns the full row.

post.description:
TAS Module 08 (Case Synthesis) as a real, citation-validated LLM call.

Never writes to canonical records — the result is persisted as a
review_status="proposed" AIAnalysisCandidate. See app/ai/reasoning.py.
Build a provenance-bearing retrieval packet for the local AI layer.

TAS Module 06 (Hypothesis and Contradiction Testing) as a real,
citation-validated LLM call. Same non-canonical-write guarantee as
/assistant/case-synthesis above.

Draft a brief/deck from a reporter-selected evidence set and a goal.

App-local reasoning module (not vendored TAS -- see
app/ai/presentation_modules/PRESENTATION_DRAFT.md), reusing the same
citation-validated LLM pipeline and non-canonical-write guarantee as
/assistant/case-synthesis and /assistant/hypothesis-test above: the
result is a review_status="proposed" AIAnalysisCandidate, promoted to
a Writeup and/or Deck only by a separate, human action.

get.description:
Server-side trace of failed OpenAleph pipeline operations (STRUCT-0027).

Covers collection setup, review refresh, and evidence/entity import --
the operations that previously left no record of *why* a 502 happened
beyond whatever the caller saw in that one HTTP response.
Transaction ledger built from canonical Payment relationships. Read-only.

The menu: every chart query, its parameters, and whether this
investigation has data for it.

post.description:
Cook, draw and check one order slip. The reply carries the data
(every value with its records), the ECharts option, the check report
and the chart's words. A failing chart is still returned, with
`report.ok` false, so the screen can show what is wrong.

get.description:
Themes, font pairings and per-visual presets/options for decks --
the one catalogue both the .pptx export and the in-app preview read.
Search canonical and evidentiary records without conflating external findings with facts.

Recent denial events (access_denied / auth_rate_limited / browser_write_denied /
request_rejected) as counts, busiest remote hosts and latest examples -- STRUCT-0035.

Local-only: this aggregates denial events (including remote IPs) across every
investigation and actor on the server, not just the caller's own scope.

Preview-only report of files under document storage that no Document row
references (STRUCT area: lifecycle.preview_orphan_document_files was implemented
and unit-tested but never wired to a route -- the frontend's "Preview retained
orphan files" button 404'd on every call). Local-only: this walks the server's
whole document storage root, not just the caller's own investigation's files.
